content.summary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings  a small Hong Kong company, is grappling with a struggling business and a Justice Department investigation. For context, only 20 of the 261 companies in the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index had a greater market value; the index doesn’t include Regencell.
